_: living-adventurers P1 — GENERALISED controller, hand-wired (the macro that auto-generates this wiring is P2). Proves the shared MFLivingWorldController (one host quest, ONE game-time tick + ONE real-time poll over a roster of reference aliases) drives TWO living NPCs of TWO archetypes. Kjeld (adventurer) rotates between the Sleeping Giant Inn (Riverwood 0x0133C6) and the Bannered Mare (Whiterun 0x01605E) — he appears in different city inns as his abstract location advances. Falas (mageApprentice) haunts the Bannered Mare. Per-NPC abstract progress = a deed GLOB ticked off-stage; tavern bard Bjorn's rumor topics gate on each deed GLOB (傳唱). Archetype is a small int → a fixed branch in MFLivingNpcAlias, so adding another adventurer/mage is pure data (a new alias + markers, no code). Off-stage state is the deed GLOB + the alias script's anchorIdx; richer per-NPC KV (task/playerRel) lands in P3 via StorageUtil. NOTE: distinct-CITY anchors here use two verified vanilla interior cells; spreading anchors to e.g. the College of Winterhold needs a main-machine-verified cell FormID (P1.5). TEST: new game / save+reload; `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn` then `coc WhiterunBanneredMare`, waiting a few in-game hours between → Kjeld materialises in whichever matches his current anchor; `getglobalvalue MFLW_KjeldDeeds` climbs off-stage; talk to Bjorn for the rumor once deeds>=1; `set MFLW_KjeldDeeds to 3` to force the rumor.

globals._: Kjeld's off-stage deed counter; rumor gates on it

packages._: Shared 'sandbox wherever I currently am' package (no Location → NearSelf). After MoveTo drops the NPC at an anchor, EvaluatePackage makes him sandbox that room instead of standing. Both archetypes use it in P1; archetype-specific packages (merchant travel, mage casting) are P3 polish via alias ALPS.

npcs.greeting: Pull up a chair, friend. I've a tale or two.

formLists._: index 0 = hold marker; 1.. = anchors. Kjeld rotates between the Sleeping Giant Inn AND the Bannered Mare. (One FLST because alias props can't resolve a placement REFR directly — see design.md gap.)
index 0 = hold; Falas haunts the Bannered Mare (single anchor in P1)

placements._: Kjeld's persistent ref, parked off-stage at the hold marker (Tamriel, buried). persistent:true is REQUIRED — a forced-alias ACHR that's MoveTo'd around must not be engine-dropped, and the deferred-anchor auto-persist set does NOT cover forced-alias targets (only package location/target slots + merchant chests). P2 macro must always emit this.
Shared off-stage holding marker (both NPCs MoveTo here when the player is elsewhere; they overlap underground, harmless).
Kjeld anchor A — Sleeping Giant Inn (Riverwood).
Bjorn the bard lives in the Sleeping Giant Inn full-time — he does the 傳唱.

quests._: Host quest. startGameEnabled so MFLivingWorldController.OnInit arms the roster tick + poll on load. type=None: background controller. Two reference aliases, one per living NPC, each carrying MFLivingNpcAlias with its archetype/anchors/holdMarker/deedGlob bound as scriptProperties; forced-filled with the placed ACHR (forcing the NPC_ base silently fails — memory).
quests.name: Living Adventurers (P1)

scripts._: The shared world controller on the host quest. AliasCount=2 → it loops aliases 0..1 each tick/poll.
